# BackpackExchange API

> Reverse-engineered internal API. Unofficial — may change without notice.

## Documentation Index
- `SKILL.md` (this file)
- `references/REFERENCE.md` (detailed endpoint docs)

## Authentication
Cookie-based (aws-waf-token) — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Dependencies
- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (3)
- `GET /__session/2/` — Retrieve session information.
- `GET /_next/static/{staticToken}/{staticToken}` — Retrieve static assets for authentication flow.
- `POST /{hash}/verify` — Verify a hash for authentication.

### Data Read (8)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve data by ID.
- `GET /{id}/v1/{v1Id}` — Retrieve data by two IDs.
- `GET /api/announcements` — Retrieve platform announcements.
- `GET /api/v1/borrowLend/markets` — Get borrow/lend market data.
- `GET /trade/{tradeId}` — Get details for a specific trade.
- `GET /v1/lst-apy` — Get LST APY data.
- `GET /wapi/v1/safe/solana` — Fetch Solana safe data.
- `GET /wapi/v1/statistics/user/quest/volume` — Get user quest volume statistics.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /{id}` — Post data to a specific ID.

### Media (2)
- `GET /{id}/image` — Retrieve an image by ID.
- `GET /start-here/downloads` — Download platform resources.

### Core API (1)
- `POST /~gitbook/__evt` — Send Gitbook event data.

### OpenClaw (Unbrowse) workflow

```typescript
// Retrieve borrow/lend market data.  This is a common read operation.

    return markets;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching borrow/lend markets:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```

  try {
    const response = await client.postId(id, data);
    console.log("Post Response:", response);
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`Error posting data to ID ${id}:`, error);
    return null;
  }
}

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Backpack Exchange's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Backpack Exchange data without official API access
- Automate actions on api.backpack.exchange (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Backpack Exchange frontend uses
